items.title: Midland County Judge Terry Johnson indicted; Chapter 87 removal pending
items.summary: Published reporting: Johnson surrendered Aug. 19 after indictment on two third-degree felonies. DA Glenn Harwood filed a Chapter 87 removal petition Aug. 6 (Cause DCV-26-01527). Judge R. Shane Seaton assigned. Separate SCJC complaint referenced; no public SCJC sanction located as of 22 Aug.

items.title: Outside prosecutor assigned in Johnson removal suit
items.summary: Judge Ben Woodward assigned Allison Palmer, 51st Judicial District Attorney, to represent the State in The State of Texas ex rel. Glenn Harwood v. Terry Johnson.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Puckett — Rangers affidavit on training substitution
items.summary: Affidavit reporting: Puckett required an employee to complete Texas Justice Court Training Center coursework in his place (July 24, 2025) and certify that he took it. No SCJC public sanction located in the current window.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Donnie Puckett convicted of abuse of official capacity
items.summary: Texas Rangers arrested Precinct 2 JP Puckett on or about Aug. 14. Nolo contendere plea the same day before Judge Todd Kassaw. Convicted of abuse of official capacity, fined $2,290, released.

items.title: 2026 interim charges summary — divorce and custody streamlining noted
items.summary: County-focused summary of interim charges published Aug. 17. Adjacent item: Senate State Affairs charge on streamlining divorce and child-custody proceedings. No new charges specifically targeting SCJC transparency, courtroom AV, judicial campaign-finance, or guardianship reform in that summary.

items.title: OCA digital court reporting study — report due not later than 1 Oct 2026
items.summary: 89th Legislature directed OCA to study digital court reporting, with Texas A&M PPRI support. No new public interim findings in the 17–22 Aug scans. Deadline remains 1 Oct 2026.
